entries.title: I Timothy 4:3
segments: Abstain from meats. Paul here denounces those who, by forbidding what is acceptable to God, would encourage a false self-denial leading to harmful results.

entries.title: I Timothy 4:4
segments: With thanksgiving. As filling a real and present need.
